I replied to Dana in her DM to say I've noted that her Tamsin Cold Chain pickups now use Dock 15. I also told her the note stays in that DM and I'll only pass it on if she asks me to send it to someone she names.

I didn't save it to the shared knowledge base, because other people can read that and she asked to keep it private. That means the note only lives in the DM thread, so if she asks about it later, it will need to be found there. She said no action was needed, so I didn't do anything else.
